raw.etymology_text: From Middle High German zimber, from Old High German zimbar, from Proto-West Germanic *timr, from Proto-Germanic *timrą, from Proto-Indo-European *dem- (“build, house”) (see Proto-Indo-European *dṓm). Cognate with English timber, Swedish timmer (“timber”), and Dutch timmer (“building; construction; room”).
